questions.stem: Which of the following is a property of a rectangle?
questions.solution: A rectangle is defined by having opposite sides that are congruent, which is a fundamental geometric property. While all angles in a rectangle are equal (each being 90 degrees), this is not the defining property being asked. A rectangle does not have all sides equal, as that would make it a square, and its diagonals are not perpendicular, unlike in a rhombus or square.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक आयत का गुण है?
hi.solution: एक आयत के विपरीत भुजाएं सर्वांगसम होती हैं, जो एक मूलभूत ज्यामितीय गुण है। एक आयत में सभी कोण समान होते हैं (प्रत्येक 90 डिग्री होता है), लेकिन यह पूछे गए परिभाषा गुण नहीं है। एक आयत में सभी भुजाएं समान नहीं होती हैं, क्योंकि ऐसा होने पर यह एक वर्ग बन जाएगा, और इसके विकर्ण लंबवत नहीं होते हैं, जैसा कि एक समचतुर्भुज या वर्ग में होता है।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses standard Hindi mathematical terminology.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणते एक चौकोनाचे गुणधर्म आहे?
mr.solution: एक चौकोनाची विशेषता विरुद्ध बाजू एकरूप असणे ही आहे, हे एक मूलभूत भूमितीय गुणधर्म आहे. चौकोनाच्या सर्व कोनांमध्ये बरोबर असतात (प्रत्येक 90 अंश असतो), हे विचारलेल्या विशेषतेचे निर्धारण नाही. चौकोनाच्या सर्व बाजू बरोबर असतात, हे चौकोन असेल तर ते चौरस असेल आणि त्याच्या कर्ण लंब असतात, हे विरुद्ध चौरस किंवा चौकोनात असतात.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Marathi geometric terminology.

questions.stem: In a trapezium, which of the following is true?
choices: Both pairs of opposite sides are parallel
Only one pair of opposite sides is parallel
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'Only one pair of opposite sides is parallel' because a trapezium is defined as a quadrilateral with exactly one pair of parallel sides. The other options describe shapes like parallelograms, rhombuses, or squares, which have different properties such as two pairs of parallel sides or all sides equal.

questions.stem: In a quadrilateral, if the diagonals are not congruent but bisect each other, what type of quadrilateral is it?
questions.solution: A parallelogram has diagonals that bisect each other, but they are not necessarily congruent. Rectangles and squares have congruent diagonals, which rules them out. A rhombus has diagonals that bisect each other at right angles but are not congruent, but it is a specific type of parallelogram. Therefore, the most general and correct answer is a parallelogram.

hi.stem: एक चतुर्भुज में, यदि विकर्ण सर्वांगसम नहीं हैं लेकिन एक दूसरे को समद्विभाजित करते हैं, तो यह कौन-सा प्रकार का चतुर्भुज है?

questions.stem: If a quadrilateral has all sides equal and all angles equal, what type of quadrilateral is it?
questions.solution: A square is a quadrilateral with all sides equal and all angles equal, making it the correct answer. A rectangle has all angles equal but not necessarily all sides equal. A rhombus has all sides equal but not necessarily all angles equal. A parallelogram may have opposite sides and angles equal, but not all sides and angles.

questions.stem: In a parallelogram, if one angle is 118°, what is the measure of its adjacent angle?
questions.solution: In a parallelogram, adjacent angles are supplementary, meaning they add up to 180°. Therefore, if one angle is 118°, the adjacent angle is 180° - 118° = 62°. The option '118°' is the measure of the opposite angle, not the adjacent one. '180°' is the sum of the two angles, not the individual measure. '72°' is the result of incorrectly subtracting from 180° in a different context.

hi.stem: एक समांतर चतुर्भुज में, यदि एक कोण 118° है, तो इसके संलग्न कोण का माप क्या है?

hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate mathematical terminology.

'118°' हे विरुद्ध कोनाचे माप आहे, जवळच्या कोनाचे नाही. '180°' हे दोन कोनांची बेरीज आहे, निर्दिष्ट माप नाही. '72°' हे 180° मधून वेगळ्या संदर्भात चुकीच्या पद्धतीने बेरीज केल्याने मिळालेले आहे.

questions.stem: If in a quadrilateral, the diagonals are equal and bisect each other, what type of quadrilateral is it?
questions.solution: A rectangle has diagonals that are equal in length and bisect each other, which matches the given condition. A rhombus has diagonals that bisect each other but are not equal. A kite has one pair of equal diagonals, but they do not bisect each other. A trapezium does not have equal diagonals or bisecting diagonals.

questions.stem: If the diagonals of a rhombus intersect at right angles and one of the diagonals is 16 cm, what is the length of half of that diagonal?
questions.solution: In a rhombus, the diagonals bisect each other. So, if one diagonal is 16 cm, half of that diagonal is 16/2 = 8 cm. The option '16 cm' is the full length of the diagonal, not half. '4 cm' is a quarter of the diagonal, not half. '32 cm' is double the length of the diagonal, which is incorrect.

hi.stem: यदि एक समचतुर्भुज के विकर्ण समकोण पर प्रतिच्छेद करते हैं और विकर्ण में से एक 16 सेमी है, तो उस विकर्ण के आधे की लंबाई क्या है?
hi.solution: एक समचतुर्भुज में, विकर्ण एक दूसरे को समद्विभाजित करते हैं। इसलिए, यदि एक विकर्ण 16 सेमी है, तो उस विकर्ण के आधे की लंबाई 16/2 = 8 सेमी है। विकल्प '16 सेमी' विकर्ण की पूरी लंबाई है, न कि आधी। '4 सेमी' विकर्ण के एक चौथाई है, न कि आधा। '32 सेमी' विकर्ण की लंबाई का दोगुना है, जो गलत है।

mr.solution: एका चौकोनात, विकर्ण एकमेकांना दुभागतात. म्हणून, जर एका विकर्णाची लांबी 16 सेंमी असेल तर त्या विकर्णाच्या अर्ध्याची लांबी 16/2 = 8 सेंमी असेल. '16 सेंमी' हा विकर्णाच्या पूर्ण लांबीचा विकल्प आहे, अर्ध्याचा नाही. '4 सेंमी' हा विकर्णाच्या चौथाईचा विकल्प आहे, अर्ध्याचा नाही. '32 सेंमी' हा विकर्णाच्या दुप्पट लांबीचा विकल्प आहे, जो चूक आहे.
